_comment: Guided tour of step 4 of the burst workflow (More samples, gui/more_samples_app.py). The steps point at the real controls and wait for the user to use them. Read by chisurf.emtk.help_guide.EmTkGuidedTour.

steps.title: More of the same
steps.text: The pipeline is tuned on the first measurement. Every measurement you add here goes through exactly that pipeline: the same setup, calibration, burst search, Burst MLE fit window and IRF, and the optional steps that ran.

steps.title: Drop the samples
steps.text: Drag measurements from the workspace table down into Samples, or drop files on the window while this step is open. A group brings all its files.

await.hint: Drag a measurement into the Samples table.

steps.title: Run
steps.text: Run processes every queued sample. The progress card's Stop stops after the current step; a sample that fails is marked failed and the others go on. Hover a row for its details.
